Concurrently, the Crypto Fear & Greed index dropped to multi-year lows, signaling pervasive risk-off sentiment. While technical indicators and on-chain accumulation by whole-coin holders suggest potential bottoming behavior and bounce setups, the immediate 24-hour headwind from stablecoin liquidity strain and acute market fear tilts the short-term probability against an upward close.
